entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: A Kav pilot from the Sothera system, first mate and flight engineer of the Seriema and best friend of Sami.

entities.name: Sami
entities.description: Captain of the Seriema, Tannuk's best friend.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: For whom Sami and Tannuk retrieved an artifact.

entities.name: Endstone
entities.description: Rock with causality-influencing powers found at Sigma's Reach.

entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: Monoist followed by the Sunstar Free Company, suspected to be one of the Endstone's chosen.

entities.name: Haliya
entities.description: Summist soldier who tried to take the Endstone from Alpharael and decided it could not fall into her people's hands.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: Summist group that followed Alpharael and massacred Taro-duend.

entities.name: Taro-duend
entities.description: Kav colony whose civilians were massacred.

entities.name: Summotank
entities.description: City Tannuk spared from a bolide.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Someone Sami and Tannuk were looking for.

events.summary: Tannuk commanded the Guns of Kavaron to fire on a bolide, sparing Summotank but killing twenty-five thousand elsewhere; he was banished from the planet.
events.quote: he was banished from the planet

events.summary: Tannuk met Captain Sami at the wreck of the Wurm Speaker and joined her crew.
events.quote: One day, they responded to the wreck of the Wurm Speaker , where he met captain Sami, and subsequently joined their crew.

events.summary: Sami and Tannuk found the Endstone at Sigma's Reach as a favor to Tezzeret.
events.quote: They found the Endstone and brought it back to their ship.

events.summary: They rescued Alpharael after his warmaker crashed.
events.quote: They managed to save the Monoist

events.summary: Haliya tried to take the Endstone from Alpharael; Sami and Tannuk fled Kavaron, and the Summists massacred Taro-duend.
events.quote: the Summists massacred the innocent civilians in Taro-duend to purge the influence of the Endstone

relations.quote: He is the best friend and first mate of Sami .
Alpharael had been followed by the Sunstar Free Company
